en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Shazaan Bin Al Khaleel, from Yunus, from Yahya Bin Talha, from his brother, 
(It has been narrated) from Abdullah Bin Suleyman who said, ‘
I hear Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘The Ablution (Wudhu) after the washing is an innovation’.
en.sarwar: 12. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Shadhan ibn al-Khalil from Yunus from Yahya ibn Talhah from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sulayman who has said the following: “
I heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘Wudu’ after Ghusl (bath) is heresy.’”
